blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: hablar de algo que no pasó en el pasado (third conditional)
mezclar pasado y presente en una misma condicional
expresar deseos y arrepentimiento con wish e if only

blocks.text: Para algo que no pasó en el pasado y su consecuencia imaginaria: if + past perfect, would have + participio. Es el si hubiera ..., habría ... del español.

head: Inglés
Realidad
rows: If I had studied, I would have passed.
No estudié y suspendí.
If we hadn't missed the train, we wouldn't have been late.
Perdimos el tren.
She would have come if you had asked her.
No se lo pediste.
What would you have done if you had lost?
No perdiste.

blocks.title: Si lo hubiera sabido = If I had known
blocks.text: El español dice Si lo hubiera sabido, habría venido (o hubiera venido). El inglés tiene una forma fija: If I had known, I would have come. Como hubiera puede ir en las dos partes en español, es fácil decir If I would have known: es incorrecto. Después de if va siempre had.

blocks.title: 'd = had o would
blocks.text: En la forma corta If I'd known, I'd have come la primera 'd es had y la segunda would. Después de if va siempre had.

head: Patrón
Ejemplo
Significado
rows: condición pasada, consecuencia presente
If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
no acepté el trabajo, no soy rico
condición presente, consecuencia pasada
If I were braver, I would have said something.
no soy valiente, no dije nada

head: Deseo sobre
Forma y ejemplo
Español
rows: el presente (no es así)
wish + past simple: I wish I had more time.
Ojalá tuviera más tiempo.
el pasado (arrepentimiento)
wish + past perfect: I wish I hadn't said that.
Ojalá no hubiera dicho eso.
el comportamiento de otro (fastidio)
wish + would: I wish you would stop talking.
A ver si te callas de una vez.
capacidad
wish + could: I wish I could swim.
Ojalá supiera nadar.

blocks.title: Ojalá = I wish
blocks.text: Donde el español usa ojalá + imperfecto de subjuntivo, el inglés usa wish + past simple: Ojalá fuera rico = I wish I were (was) rich. Y con el pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo, past perfect: Ojalá hubiera escuchado = I wish I had listened. Ojo: para un deseo sobre el futuro (ojalá llueva mañana) se usa I hope: I hope it rains tomorrow. If only es más fuerte: If only I had listened!
4. it's time, I'd rather, as if

head: Expresión
Ejemplo
Español
rows: it's time + past simple
It's time we went home.
Ya es hora de que nos vayamos a casa.
I'd rather + verbo
I'd rather stay in tonight.
Prefiero quedarme en casa esta noche.
I'd rather + persona + past
I'd rather you didn't smoke.
Prefiero que no fumes.
as if / as though
He talks as if he knew everything.
Habla como si lo supiera todo.
If I would have known, I would have come.
If I had known, I would have come.
Después de if: past perfect.
If she had asked, I had helped her.
If she had asked, I would have helped her.
En la frase principal: would have.
I wish I have more money.
I wish I had more money.
wish sobre el presente: past simple.
I wish I didn't say that yesterday.
I wish I hadn't said that yesterday.
Arrepentimiento sobre el pasado: past perfect.
It's time we go home.
It's time we went home.
it's time + past simple.
I'd rather to stay here.
I'd rather stay here.
Después de I'd rather no va to.
If I had taken the job, I would have been rich now.
If I had taken the job, I would be rich now.
Consecuencia presente: would + verbo.

blocks.text: Completa con la forma correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: If I ______ the answer, I would have told you.
items.full: If I had known the answer, I would have told you.

items.q: If we had left earlier, we ______ the train.
items.full: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

items.q: I wish I ______ to the party last night.
items.full: I wish I had gone to the party last night.

items.q: I wish you ______ stop interrupting me!
items.full: I wish you would stop interrupting me!
If only I could speak Chinese.
It's time you got a job.
I'd rather stay at home tonight.

items.q: If she had taken the medicine, she ______ better now.
items.full: If she had taken the medicine, she would feel better now.

items.q: He looks ______ if he hasn't slept for days.
items.full: He looks as if he hasn't slept for days.

items.q: Si lo hubiera sabido, habría venido.
items.a: If I had known, I would have come.
I wish I had more time.
I wish I hadn't said that.

items.q: Ya es hora de que nos vayamos a casa.
